caption: The drawing depicts a metallic trivet with a flat, shield-shaped body, featuring a central openwork design that resembles a stylized cross or fleur-de-lis with a notched, pointed end. The body is bordered by a raised rim that follows the overall shield-like contour. The top section of the drawing shows a plan view, a side view, and a small scale bar for reference. The color of the drawing is monochromatic, rendered in shades of gray and black, providing contrast to emphasize the edges and inner shapes. The bottom section illustrates the object in an isometric or three-quarter view, highlighting its three-dimensional form and the way the decorative cut-out structure is raised above four short supporting legs at each corner. The composition is arranged so that the trivet is centered and occupies most of the space on a light, untextured background. The artist's signature is present at the lower left corner of the image.
title: Flat Iron Holder
